# Audio & Autoplay Checklist: Player Cinematográfico de Quadros

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade dos requisitos de áudio — ativo por padrão, respeitando
as políticas de autoplay, controle único de ligar/desligar, preferência persistida e
compreensão sem som. Os requisitos estão completos, claros, consistentes e mensuráveis?
**Created**: 2026-09-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | Contrato: [storage-contract.md](../contracts/storage-contract.md) | UI: [player-ui-contract.md](../contracts/player-ui-contract.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Completude dos Requisitos

- [x] CHK001 Is the exact activation gesture defined for when autoplay is blocked (any user gesture vs a specific control), and does the requirement reflect that playback must be tied to a qualifying gesture? [Gap, Spec §FR-016] — qualquer gesto qualificado (FR-016)
- [x] CHK002 Is the audio behavior at scene boundaries specified (stop, continue, restart, or crossfade), including transitions into scenes without audio? [Gap, Spec §FR-006] — crossfade ≤500 ms + silêncio
- [x] CHK003 Is the state shown by the audio control defined when the preference is "on" but the browser has blocked autoplay (muted vs on)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014/§FR-016] — terceiro estado "bloqueado"
- [x] CHK004 Is the audio playback position specified when re-enabling mid-scene (resume position vs restart of the track)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006] — retoma da posição
- [x] CHK005 Is it specified whether enabling/disabling audio uses a fade or an abrupt cut, and whether any transition duration is bounded? [Gap, Spec §FR-006] — resolvido: corte imediato com micro-rampa anti-clique, conclusão ≤100 ms; fade-in ≤300 ms ao religar
- [x] CHK006 Is a per-user volume-control requirement defined or explicitly excluded (given WCAG 1.4.2 accepts stop/pause)? [Coverage, Gap] — FR-020 volume persistido
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for audio loading/preloading and its interaction with slow connections? [Gap, Spec §FR-015] — resolvido: pré-carga da trilha da cena corrente e da seguinte (FR-015); áudio ativo a ~48–64 kbps sob economia de dados (FR-031)
- [x] CHK008 Is "tocar de forma coerente com a cena" quantified (which track, sync point, and when it starts relative to the frame)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006] — trilha da cena na entrada; resume/mix
- [x] CHK009 Is "imediatamente" for audio cessation quantified with a maximum latency threshold? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006] — ≤100 ms
- [x] CHK010 Is "controle único e sempre acessível" defined with placement, on-screen persistence, and discoverability criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005/§SC-002] — barra persistente + SC-002
- [x] CHK011 Is the visible audio state (on/off/blocked) defined with measurable indicators, including its accessible state semantics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014] — resolvido: `aria-pressed` binário + `aria-disabled="true"` e `role="status"` para "bloqueado", rótulo fixo
- [x] CHK012 Are the exact conditions under which the browser autoplay block is considered to have occurred specified (detection signal)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016] — resolvido: bloqueio = recusa de permissão de reprodução, distinta de falha de carregamento (FR-032)
- [x] CHK013 Is the conflict resolved between first-gesture auto-activation (FR-016) and an explicit stored "off" preference (FR-007 / Storage Contract)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-016/§FR-007] — "off" tem precedência; só o controle religa
- [x] CHK014 Do "audio starts active by default" (FR-004) and "respect autoplay policy" (FR-016) define precedence and observable behavior for every visit type? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004/§FR-016] — FR-004/FR-016/SC-003 + storage contract
- [x] CHK015 Does SC-007 (100% of return visits preserve audio preference) account for unavailable or evicted storage (private mode, Safari)? [Conflict, Spec §SC-007, Storage Contract] — cláusula de exceção
- [x] CHK016 Is the default audio volume/level requirement defined and consistent with the manifest default (0.6)? [Consistency, Data-Model §AudioTrack] — FR-020 padrão 0,6
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for toggling audio during a transition or during a scene change? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-006] — edge case + crossfade
- [x] CHK018 Is the behavior specified when a scene references a missing or failed-to-load audio file? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases] — FR-032 silêncio sem erro
- [x] CHK019 Are requirements defined so that sound-dependent narrative information is conveyed in text for users with audio off (FR-008)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008/§SC-004] — FR-008/FR-012/SC-004/SC-013
- [x] CHK020 Is the interaction between autoplay-blocked silence and the persisted "on" preference specified for subsequent frames and scenes? [Gap, Spec §FR-016] — ativação vale para a sessão
- [x] CHK021 Does FR-008 (comprehensible without audio) trace to concrete content/description requirements? [Traceability, Spec §FR-008] — FR-012/SC-013 + schema
- [x] CHK022 Is the audio control's keyboard shortcut (M) traceable to both a functional requirement and an accessibility requirement? [Traceability, UI Contract, Spec §FR-010] — FR-010 + UI contract
- [x] CHK023 Is the relationship between the audio control and WCAG 1.4.2 (mechanism available for audio >3 s) documented? [Traceability, Constitution §V] — UI contract + tabela WCAG

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- **Review 2026-09-23**: revisão por agente + sessão de `/speckit.clarify`; todos os critérios passaram a ser satisfeitos pelas atualizações de `spec.md`, `data-model.md`, `player-ui-contract.md` e `storage-contract.md`.
- **Re-review 2026-09-23 (2ª passada)**: CHK005 e CHK019 reabertos e resolvidos — fade-in ≤300 ms e pistas sonoras em FR-012/SC-013.
- **Re-review 2026-09-23 (3ª passada, agente independente)**: CHK005, CHK007, CHK011 e CHK012 reabertos e **resolvidos** — corte imediato com micro-rampa (≤100 ms); pré-carga da cena seguinte e áudio a 96 kbps sob economia de dados; ARIA tri-estado (`aria-pressed` + `aria-disabled` + `role="status"`); detecção de bloqueio separada de falha de arquivo. Também documentado: pool de elementos pré-criados desbloqueados no gesto (política per-element do Safari) no contrato de UI. Pendência de confirmação estética: fade-out do desligar (ver clarify).
